name: dev-flow
description: A compact Codex workflow plugin for low-noise repository orientation, task planning, and knowledge distillation.

interface.shortDescription: Orient, plan, and distill coding work.
interface.longDescription: Dev Flow provides three focused Codex skills: dev-orient to enter repository context without noise, dev-plan to create a minimal verifiable task plan, and dev-distill to turn completed work into durable project knowledge.
defaultPrompt: Use dev-orient to enter this repository context.
Use dev-plan to define the next task.
Use dev-distill to preserve durable project knowledge.
